name: tanod-documents
description: PDF and Office document tools: extract text and tables, OCR, convert between PDF, Word, Excel and PowerPoint, and edit PDFs.

interface.longDescription: Tanod Documents turns files into the files you need, inside ChatGPT, with 38 tools that work on a public URL (or small files sent inline). Convert: PDF to an editable Word file, Word, Excel or PowerPoint to PDF, HTML to PDF, images to PDF, PDF to images. Extract: tables to CSV or Excel, bank statement PDFs to transactions (CSV, Excel, OFX, QIF), any Office or PDF file to Markdown, Excel to JSON, OCR for scanned PDFs and images. Edit PDFs: merge, split, reorder, rotate, crop, resize, compress, watermark, page numbers, bookmarks, metadata, password protect, fill and flatten forms, repair. Build: fill a DOCX template from JSON, build a PPTX deck or an XLSX workbook. Input files are processed for the one call and not kept; output download links expire after 24 hours. Results are automated. No account is needed.
capabilities: Convert PDF to Word and Office files to PDF
Bank statement PDFs to CSV, Excel, OFX or QIF
Tables from PDFs to CSV or Excel
Merge, split, rotate, compress and watermark PDFs
Fill PDF forms and DOCX templates
